INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

2. When practising Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening: Poetry.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.

4. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting: Neatness and Legibility.

7. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
